by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C D _ hs hpar hne hleg
  have hBA : B ≠ A := fun h => hs.2.1 (h ▸ left_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A C)
  rw [AffineSubspace.affineSpan_pair_parallel_iff_vectorSpan_eq, vectorSpan_pair_rev, vectorSpan_pair_rev] at hpar
  have m1 : C -ᵥ D ∈ Submodule.span ℝ {B -ᵥ A} := by rw [hpar]; exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp m1
  have hkpos : 0 < k := by
    by_contra hk0
    rcases (not_lt.mp hk0).lt_or_eq with hneg | hz
    · have hD : D = (-k) • (B -ᵥ A) +ᵥ C := by
        rw [neg_smul, hk, neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev, vsub_vadd]
      have h3 := AffineSubspace.sSameSide_smul_vsub_vadd_left (s := line[ℝ, A, C]) hs.2.1
        (left_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A C) (right_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A C) (neg_pos.mpr hneg)
      rw [← hD] at h3
      exact h3.symm.not_sOppSide hs
    · rw [hz, zero_smul] at hk
      exact hs.2.2 (vsub_eq_zero_iff_eq.mp hk.symm ▸ right_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A C)
  set u : V := B -ᵥ A with hu
  set v : V := D -ᵥ A with hv
  have hk1 : k ≠ 1 := by
    rintro rfl
    apply hne
    rw [dist_comm A B, dist_comm D C, dist_eq_norm_vsub V B A, dist_eq_norm_vsub V C D, ← hk, one_smul]
  have hCA : C -ᵥ A = k • u + v := by rw [hk, hv, vsub_add_vsub_cancel]
  have hCB : C -ᵥ B = v + (k - 1) • u := by
    rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right C B A, hCA, ← hu]; module
  have hDB : D -ᵥ B = v - u := (vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right D B A).symm
  have hu0 : u ≠ 0 := vsub_ne_zero.mpr hBA
  have hupos : 0 < ‖u‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
  have nsq : ∀ (a b : ℝ), ‖a • u + b • v‖ ^ 2 = a ^ 2 * ‖u‖ ^ 2 + 2 * a * b * inner ℝ u v + b ^ 2 * ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro a b
    rw [norm_add_sq_real, norm_smul, norm_smul, mul_pow, mul_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, sq_abs,
      real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right]
    ring
  have hE : 2 * inner ℝ u v = (1 - k) * ‖u‖ ^ 2 := by
    have h1 : ‖v‖ = ‖C -ᵥ B‖ := by
      rw [hv, ← dist_eq_norm_vsub V D A, ← dist_eq_norm_vsub V C B, dist_comm D A, dist_comm C B, hleg]
    rw [hCB] at h1
    have h2 := nsq (k - 1) 1
    rw [one_smul, add_comm, ← h1] at h2
    have h3 : (k - 1) * (2 * inner ℝ u v - (1 - k) * ‖u‖ ^ 2) = 0 := by linear_combination -h2
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h3 with h | h
    · exact absurd (by linarith) hk1
    · linarith
  constructor
  · rw [dist_comm A C, dist_comm B D, dist_eq_norm_vsub V C A, dist_eq_norm_vsub V D B, hCA, hDB]
    have e1 := nsq k 1
    have e2 := nsq (-1) 1
    rw [one_smul] at e1 e2
    rw [neg_smul, one_smul, add_comm, ← sub_eq_add_neg] at e2
    apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
    rw [e1, e2]
    linear_combination (k + 1) * hE
  · unfold EuclideanGeometry.angle InnerProductGeometry.angle
    rw [← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev B A, ← hu, hCB, ← hv]
    have hn : ‖v + (k - 1) • u‖ = ‖v‖ := by
      rw [← hCB, ← dist_eq_norm_vsub V C B, dist_comm, ← hleg, dist_comm, dist_eq_norm_vsub V D A]
    rw [hn, norm_neg, inner_neg_left, inner_add_right, inner_smul_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq,
      real_inner_comm u v, mul_comm ‖v‖ ‖u‖]
    congr 2
    linear_combination hE
